issues.failure_explanation:
The displayed chain estimate claims that shifting the integrand phi_{|nabla v_h(T)|}(t) from the shift |nabla v_h(T)| to |nabla v_h(T_+)| along a chain of face neighbors costs only a remainder delta * sum_j h_{T_j} * integral_{gamma_j} phi_{|nabla v_h(T_j)|}(|llbracket nabla_h e_h rrbracket_{gamma_j}|) ds, i.e., delta times terms of the same functional form as those being bounded. But the cited shift-change (Proposition prop:Properties, itm:shiftChange) is phi_{|P|}(t) <= (1+C_delta) phi_{|Q|}(t) + delta |F(Q)-F(P)|^2, whose remainder depends only on the two shift vectors P,Q and not on the argument t. Iterating along the chain therefore yields constants built from jumps of nabla_h v_h (via Proposition prop:Distances: |F(nabla v_h(T_j)) - F(nabla v_h(T_{j+1}))|^2 eqsim phi_{|
abla v_h(T_j)|}(|llbracket nabla_h v_h rrbracket_{gamma_j}|)), never phi-of-jumps of e_h. These remainders (whether read as written, with e_h-jumps, or corrected to jumps of nabla_h v_h) are of a different functional type than the terms of the sum in (eq:Proofaaaassskkk0) (which involve jumps of nabla_h e_h) and of the target estimates (eq:Proofaaaassskkk02)/(eq:Enrichment2) (which involve only grad_h(e_h - v)-terms and the divergence term); constants built from jumps of nabla_h v_h cannot be absorbed into them. Hence the passage from (eq:Proofaaaassskkk0) to (eq:Proofaaaassskkk02), and with it the proof of (eq:Enrichment2), is invalid as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restructure the proof to keep the native elementwise shifts throughout (on T the shift |grad v_h(T)| coincides with the global shift |grad_h v_h|), apply the Case-1/Case-2 bubble bounds face-by-face directly to the incidences (T,gamma) of (eq:Proofaaaassskkk0), and use the shift-change only across the two traces of a single face, where the remainder delta*|llbracket F(grad_h v_h) rrbracket_gamma|^2 has a form the surrounding estimates absorb; this uses only tools already present (itm:shiftChange, itm:Udal, bubble arguments) and re-establishes (eq:Proofaaaassskkk02) and (eq:Enrichment2).
issues.overall_effect: The second estimate (eq:Enrichment2) of Lemma lem:confComp is left unproven. Since the proofs of Theorem thm:mainResult (Steps 1-3 absorb int phi_{|grad_h v_h|}(h^{-1}|e_h - cE e_h|) and int phi_{|grad_h v_h|}(|grad_h(e_h - E e_h)|) via this estimate), of Theorem thm:ApproxProperties, and hence of Theorems thm:Apriori and thm:AprioriConf all invoke it, the paper's central quasi-optimality guarantee and both a priori estimates are left without a valid supporting argument.
issues.title: Shift-change chain estimate in Lemma lem:confComp produces non-absorbable remainders of the wrong form
issues.why_classification: The repair reorganizes the shift handling inside one lemma using the paper's existing toolbox (shift-change, itm:Udal, bubble arguments); no new global proof architecture is needed and the final guarantees of the paper survive in comparable form, but the fix is a contained nontrivial restructuring rather than a local one-line correction.

issues.failure_explanation: Item itm:Udal states (phi_{|Q|})*(|A(Q)-A(P)|) eqsim phi_{|Q|}(|Q-P|): the shift must be the trace |Q| of one of the two gradients that are paired through A(.). In (eq:Proofaaq34) the paired gradients are the two traces grad_h e_h(T_+-) of e_h = v_h - u_h (with arbitrary u_h in V_h), but the shift in both integrands is |grad v_h(T_+)|, the trace of grad_h v_h, to which grad_h e_h is unrelated. With a foreign shift the equivalence is false in general (e.g., for phi(t)=t^p/p the two sides differ by a factor of order |grad_h e_h(T_+)|^{2(p-2)}/|grad v_h(T_+)|^{2(p-2)} in the quadratic regime), and deriving it via the shift-change would create remainders delta|F(grad v_h(T_+)) - F(grad_h e_h(T_+-))|^2 that no term of the target estimate (eq:Enrichment2) controls. The same foreign-shift defect recurs when (phi_{|grad v_h(T_+)|})*(|A(grad v)-A(grad_h e_h)|) is converted into phi_{|grad_h v_h|}(|grad_h(v-e_h)|)-scale terms in (eq:ProofFINALL). Case 2 of the proof of (eq:Enrichment2) is therefore unjustified.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: The shift-change in Proposition~\ref{prop:Properties}~\ref{itm:shiftChange} and Lemma~\ref{lem:Oscillation} yield

issues.failure_explanation: The only source for the additional term is Lemma lem:confComp, whose estimate (eq:Enrichment2) provides the divergence term in the conjugate scale, int_Omega (phi_{|grad_h v_h|})*(h_tria |div A(grad v)|) dx, as its proof (the pairing of the jump of A(grad_h e_h).nu via itm:Udal) indeed produces conjugate integrands. Theorem thm:ApproxProperties states the additional term as the primal integral int_Omega phi_{|grad v|}(h_tria |div A(grad v)|)dx, and (eq:ProofTemp0223) silently substitutes the conjugate by the primal function. The shift-change (itm:shiftChange) changes shifts but never converts (phi)^* into phi, and for phi(t)=t^p/p the two integrands behave like |Q|^{p-2}(ht)^2 + (ht)^p versus |Q|^{2-p}(ht)^2 + (ht)^{p'}, so neither dominates the other uniformly; the stated extra term therefore does not follow from the cited material. The defect becomes fatal in the proof of Theorem thm:AprioriConf, which must absorb the primal term int phi_{|grad u|}(h_tria|f|) into the error plus the oscillation, citing the shift-change and Lemma lem:Oscillation; that lemma controls only conjugate integrands int_T (phi_{|grad_h v_h|})*(h_T|f|), and the needed primal bound is false in general: for the p-Laplacian with p>2 in regions where |grad u| is large, f = -div A(grad u) is of size |grad u|^{p-2}|D^2 u|, so int_T phi_{|grad u|}(h_T|f|)dx exceeds the dual oscillation and the best-approximation error by a factor of order |grad u|^{2(p-2)}. Hence Theorem thm:AprioriConf is not established by its proof.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: State the additional term of Theorem thm:ApproxProperties with the conjugate integrand, int_Omega (phi_{|grad v|})^*(h_tria |div A(grad v)|)dx (which is what Lemma lem:confComp delivers after a legitimate shift-change), and in the proof of Theorem thm:AprioriConf replace the primal term int phi_{|grad u|}(h|f|) by this conjugate term, which Lemma lem:Oscillation does control (its first bound is exactly int_T (phi_{|grad_h v_h|})^*(h_T|f|) <=~ err^2 + osc^2); with these local integrand corrections the stated conclusion of Theorem thm:AprioriConf is recovered.
issues.overall_effect: The stated interpolation estimate of Theorem thm:ApproxProperties (with the primal divergence term) is not supported by its proof, and the proof of Theorem thm:AprioriConf -- the novel localized a priori estimate for the conforming lowest-order Lagrange FEM advertised in the abstract and introduction -- fails at the step that absorbs int phi_{|grad u|}(h_tria|f|) into err^2 + osc^2(u,f;T); the claimed quasi-optimality-type estimate for the conforming FEM is unsupported as written.
issues.title: Divergence term stated with the primal shifted N-function where only the conjugate is available; claimed absorption into the oscillation is false in general
issues.why_classification: The repair is a contained change of integrand (phi replaced by its Legendre conjugate, plus the matching shift-change) in the statement of thm:ApproxProperties and in one step of the proof of thm:AprioriConf; the headline guarantee of thm:AprioriConf (error <= best approximation + data oscillation) then follows from the existing tools, so the loss is confined to the intermediate theorem's extra term rather than to any advertised guarantee.
